question: Product of Array Except Self

def product_except_self(nums):
    n = len(nums)
    out = [1] * n
    left = 1
    for i in range(n):
        out[i] = left
        left *= nums[i]
    right = 1
    for i in range(n - 1, -1, -1):
        out[i] *= right
        right *= nums[i]
    return out

title: First and Last Position of Target
question: Given sorted array, return [first,last] index of target or [-1,-1].

solution.code:
def searchRange(nums,target):
    lo,hi=0,len(nums)-1
    while lo<=hi:
        m=(lo+hi)//2
        if nums[m]<target: lo=m+1
        else: hi=m-1
    first=lo
    if first>=len(nums) or nums[first]!=target: return [-1,-1]
    lo,hi=0,len(nums)-1
    while lo<=hi:
        m=(lo+hi)//2
        if nums[m]<=target: lo=m+1
        else: hi=m-1
    return [first, lo-1]

    if not nums: return []
    out=[]; i=0
    while i<len(nums):
        j=i
        while j+1<len(nums) and nums[j+1]==nums[j]+1: j+=1
        out.append(str(nums[i]) if i==j else f'{nums[i]}->{nums[j]}')
        i=j+1
    return out
